manualTitle: 2021 Acura TLX 2.0T SH-AWD — Full maintenance schedule (U.S. owner's manual)

coverage.included: All U.S. Maintenance Minder main/sub items (P. 527); Code B inspection bundle as separate rows; owner periodic checks (P. 520); under-hood owner checks (oil, coolant, battery, tires, wipers).
coverage.excluded: 3.0L-only timing belt/water pump (P. 527 *5); cosmetic cleaning (P. 569–571); emergency/flat-tire procedures; separate paper maintenance booklet referenced at P. 520; dealer-only LED light assembly service unless failed.

documentRef.note: TLX scheduling is Maintenance-Minder-adaptive. Miles/months are projection baselines from OEM footnotes where stated; MM-triggered items may have no fixed interval.

entries.serviceName: Replace engine oil (Maintenance Minder A)
entries.sourcePage: P. 527 — Code A (*1 change annually if no MM alert within 12 mo)

entries.serviceName: Replace engine oil and filter (Maintenance Minder B)
Inspect front and rear brakes (Maintenance Minder B)
Check Temporary Tire Repair Kit bottle expiration (Maintenance Minder B, if equipped)
Inspect tie rod ends, steering gearbox, and boots (Maintenance Minder B)
Inspect suspension components (Maintenance Minder B)
Inspect driveshaft boots (Maintenance Minder B)
Inspect brake hoses and lines including ABS/VSA (Maintenance Minder B)
Inspect all fluid levels and condition of fluids (Maintenance Minder B)
Inspect exhaust system (Maintenance Minder B, emissions warranty item)
Inspect fuel lines and connections (Maintenance Minder B, emissions warranty item)
Rotate tires (Maintenance Minder 1)
Replace engine air cleaner element (Maintenance Minder 2)
entries.sourcePage: P. 527 — Code 2 (*2 every 15,000 mi in dusty conditions; MM may trigger sooner)

entries.serviceName: Replace dust and pollen (cabin) filter (Maintenance Minder 2)
entries.sourcePage: P. 527 — Code 2 (*3 every 15,000 mi in urban soot; P. 568 — replace sooner in dusty areas)

entries.serviceName: Inspect drive belt (Maintenance Minder 2)
entries.sourcePage: P. 527 — Code 2; adjust valves during A/B/1/2/3 if noisy

entries.serviceName: Replace transmission fluid and transfer fluid (Maintenance Minder 3)
entries.sourcePage: P. 527 — Code 3; P. 546 — Acura ATF Type 2.0, dealer service

entries.serviceName: Replace spark plugs (Maintenance Minder 4, 2.0L)
Inspect valve clearance (Maintenance Minder 4, 2.0L)
Replace engine coolant — Acura Long Life Type 2 (Maintenance Minder 5)
Replace rear differential fluid — SH-AWD (Maintenance Minder 6)
entries.sourcePage: P. 527 — Code 6 (*7 first 7,500 mi then 15,000 mi under mountainous/low-speed stress; MM otherwise)

entries.serviceName: Replace brake fluid (Maintenance Minder 7)
entries.sourcePage: P. 527 — Code 7 (*8 every 3 years if no code 7 within 36 mo)

entries.serviceName: Check brake fluid level (owner periodic inspection)
Check tire pressure and tread wear (owner periodic inspection)
Check exterior lights operation (owner periodic inspection)
Check wiper blade condition (owner periodic inspection)
entries.sourcePage: P. 520 — at least every six months; P. 550 — replace when streaking

entries.serviceName: Check engine oil level (every refuel)
Check engine coolant level (every refuel)
Refill windshield washer fluid (as needed)
Check battery terminals for corrosion
Tire age inspection (annual after 5 years; replace all tires after 10 years)
Replace remote transmitter CR2032 battery (if equipped with remote start)
Turbo engine — follow Maintenance Minder for oil changes (do not rev cold)
entries.sourcePage: P. 518–519 — Turbo Engine Vehicle; oil/filter per MM
